environment.description: EC2 instance (i-0a3f8b2c1d4e5f6a7) running in VPC vpc-0abc123def456 in us-east-1. Application Load Balancer (ALB) forwards all traffic on port 443 to target group containing this instance on port 8080. ALB security group sg-0feed1234 allows inbound 0.0.0.0/0 on port 443. Instance security group sg-0dead5678 allows inbound from sg-0feed1234 on port 8080. No WAF attached. PostgreSQL RDS instance in same VPC with appuser having SELECT/INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE on all tables. Public DNS resolves to ALB.

config.alb_listener_rules: default action: forward to target group tg-legacy-app
config.security_groups: ALB sg allows 0.0.0.0/0:443 inbound; instance sg allows ALB sg:8080
